items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: No, I never did hear him. Only on records.

ctx.x: Yeah. We had to do a lot of that. Especially when you'd get playing on these hotel jobs. In the Trianon Ballroom you had to play a lot that way. Up in South Dakota, back through Illinois. Because them bands came out of that way, King...and I can't think of that other band. [JAN GARBER?] Anyway, they was all sweet bands, and that was their territory, right through that way. They would hardly ever come down this way.
